warnings: Truss connection details of S-06 (all 'No,Scale'). element_id = the printed callout ('ขยาย 1', 'ขยาย 2', 'ขยาย 3', cut '1-1'), the convention house 125 uses for 'แบบขยาย N'. Where each sits comes from the callout bubbles on the T1/T2 elevations: '(ขยาย 1)' at both eaves of T1 and T2, '(ขยาย 2)' at the A and C supports of T1, '(ขยาย 3)' at the A and C supports of T2, cut ① at the reinforced end panels ('ระยะทาบ ~3.00ม').

ขยาย 2 / ขยาย 3: the truss bears on two welded stub posts (เหล็กกล่อง 2 ◻ 100X50X3.2, 0.20 high) standing on the 0.25x0.25 x 6 มม plate on the column head 0.35 x 0.45; the truss soffit is '~0.12' (ขยาย 2, on RB1) and '~0.14' (ขยาย 3, on RB2) above the beam top — the same clearance S-04 prints as 'เว้นระยะ 0.12 ม' (already in the grid master's unassigned_dimensions). These offsets are inside one connection, so they stay on the elements (§4 rule 4: element-internal), not as z levels.

ขยาย 3's plan labels the chord 'T1 เหล็กกล่อง ◻ 100X50X3.2 mm' although its callout '(ขยาย 3)' is drawn only on the T2 elevation. Both trusses use the same ◻ 100x50x3.2 member (view1), so the section is unaffected; recorded as printed with part_of 'T2' from the callout position and flagged plan_label_reads_T1.

Cut 1-1 shows the end-panel reinforcement: chord ◻ 100X50X3.2 with a C-100x50x20x3.2 welded alongside over a ~3.00 m lap ('เชื่อมไฟฟ้าตลอดแนว') — the 'ระยะทาบเสริมความแข็งแรง T1 / T2 (ดูขยาย)' zone of S-05 (grid dummy B'').

ขยาย 1 carries no structural rebar — eave trim: fascia boards 6" / 8", bird stop, C-75x45x15x2.3 eave runner welded to the T1/T2 ends. Kept for the steel member it names. Extracted in the 2026-10-22 resume run.
